UPSTREAM: dma-buf/sw_sync: clean up list before signaling the fence If userspace already dropped its own reference by closing the sw_sync fence fd we might end up in a deadlock where dma_fence_is_signaled_locked() will trigger the release of the fence and thus try to hold the lock to remove the fence from the list. dma_fence_is_signaled_locked() tries to release/free the fence and hold the lock in the process. We fix that by changing the order operation and clean up the list and rb-tree first. v2: Drop fence get/put dance and manipulate the list first (Chris Wilson) BUG=chromium:738131 TEST=run Angry Birds on kevin Cc: Chris Wilson <chris@chris-wilson.co.uk> Signed-off-by: Gustavo Padovan <gustavo.padovan@collabora.com> Reviewed-by: Chris Wilson <chris@chris-wilson.co.uk> Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20170729152217.8362-2-gustavo@padovan.org (cherry picked from commit 3792b7c1a70815fe4e954221c096f9278638fd21) Signed-off-by: Dominik Behr <dbehr@chromium.org> Change-Id: I3344c8babf26fae3e61bc538fc43f6da5c782723 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/669294 Commit-Ready: Dominik Behr <dbehr@chromium.org> Tested-by: Dominik Behr <dbehr@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Stéphane Marchesin <marcheu@chromium.org>

intel: ipu3: Limit requests triggered by statistics event to 2 [Issue] There are 5 video related CTS cases failed. [Root Cause] After camera opened, there is no statistics for initial requests, and it caused very bad AWB experience. So we postpone requests. The request is not handle immediately in HAL which is processed, but after statistics is received. But it causes frame drop. This change limits the requests number triggered by statistics event to 2 and keeps good AWB experience. [Changes] Limit the requests number triggered by statistics event to 2. [Test Platform] Chrome BUG=b:62358788 TEST=Basic camera functions work and the case pass on soraka. Change-Id: I11ea4f7407f025e13b3b01d82291744cdbdabb03 Signed-off-by: Qingwu Zhang <qingwu.zhang@intel.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/720500 Commit-Ready: WeiX Meng <weix.meng@intel.com> Tested-by: WeiX Meng <weix.meng@intel.com> Reviewed-by: Ricky Liang <jcliang@chromium.org>

intel: ipu3: Update AIC parameter for Jpeg stream [Issue] Preview stream graph config is used to create AIC parameter if jpeg stream resolution is smaller than preview stream. [Root Cause] We use video node graph config to AIC if it exists but don't check if the jpeg stream output from video node [Changes] 1.mVideoRuntimeParams is used for AIC parameter if jpeg stream has the largest resolution which means jpeg stream output from video node and mPreviewRuntimeParams is uesd if not 2.mVideoRuntimeParams is used if no jpeg stream and video node enabled and mPreviewRuntimeParams is used if no jpeg stream and no video node enabled BUG=b:62358788 TEST=Basic camera functions work on soraka Change-Id: I7ffbb3b1ce180eba0bc95cc374cebe79341b2ffa Signed-off-by: daxingli <daxing.li@intel.com> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/686555 Commit-Ready: WeiX Meng <weix.meng@intel.com> Tested-by: WeiX Meng <weix.meng@intel.com> Reviewed-by: Ricky Liang <jcliang@chromium.org>
